en.t: I had no choice but to withdraw.

units.source_text: 一股不满的情绪燃遍了我的全身。

en.t: A feeling of dissatisfaction burned through my whole body.

units.source_text: 自己所干的不可理解的罪恶行为，得到了意味着奖励的香烟，

en.t: The incomprehensible sinful act I had committed had been rewarded with cigarettes,

units.source_text: 不了解原委就把香烟接受下来的老师……

en.t: and the teacher had accepted the cigarettes without knowing what lay behind them...

units.source_text: 这一系列的关系，理应还有更富戏剧性的、更激烈的东西。

en.t: This whole chain of connections ought to have contained something more dramatic and more intense.
Yet the teacher was completely unaware of it.

units.source_text: 这事便成为促使我轻蔑老师的又一个重要的原因。

en.t: This became another important reason that made me despise the teacher.
